name: Neha Dhull
bio: My name is Neha Dhull, and I am a PhD-trained physicist specializing in the synthesis and characterization of thin films and two-dimensional magnetic materials. My research focuses on understanding surface- and geometry-driven ferromagnetism in van der Waals materials using advanced scanning probe and optical techniques. I am passionate about exploring fundamental materials physics while keeping an eye on applications in nanotechnology and advanced functional materials.
